description: Hydropower and Flood Risk - Study site and Control site data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sarath Suresh, Faisal Hossain (University of Washington). This dataset contains the study site and control site geospatial data that were used for various analysis in the study titled 'Has Hydropower made the world Flood-prone?', submitted for publication with AGU Earth's Future. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
